hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate T(f,k,x) by replacing f, k, and x with the listed unary functions and variable. The full raw expression is the sum of the two resulting instantiations.
required_assumptions: V and W are unary function symbols
G0 and H0 are unary function symbols
p and q are independent variables
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands share the same repeated outer-factor/kernel structure f(x)*k(x)*f(x), differing only by function names and variable labels. No deeper algebraic relation between p and q is assumed.
